section_summary: This section documents State, Army, and Commerce Department processing of military entry permits, theater clearances, and U.S. exit-permit waivers for business travelers and returning residents going to occupied Japan. It includes individual applications, correspondence with foreign missions, Commerce-approved traveler lists, and deliberations over whether nationality or corporate affiliation should determine responsibility for alien employees’ applications. A separate policy sequence establishes advance reporting of Soviet and Soviet-satellite nationals transiting Japan, Korea, and Okinawa.

subfiles.title: Commerce memorandum concerning Victor Kelly Bashi
subfiles.to: Herbert Corkran Jr., Department of State
subfiles.about: Commerce forwards information about Bashi's unexplained departure from Japan.
subfiles.summary: Commerce found no record explaining Bashi's clearance and reports that his firm has sent another representative.

subfiles.title: New York Regional Office memorandum on Victor Kelly Bashi
subfiles.about: Reports Bashi's nationality, employment, wartime residence, and present whereabouts.
subfiles.summary: Bashi was Burma-born, held a British passport, worked in Kobe, remained in Japan during the war, and later moved to Bangkok.

subfiles.title: Illegible Vincent E. Sampson fragment
subfiles.about: An almost wholly illegible fragment names Vincent E. Sampson.
subfiles.summary: Unidentified fragment containing a name and partial address or business text.

subfiles.title: Military permit letter to Victor Kelly Bashi
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Transmits a June 1948 military permit and requests departure details.
subfiles.summary: Bashi receives permit 12449 and is asked for travel details so his U.S. exit permit can be waived.

subfiles.title: Letter to J. D. Scott concerning Bashi
subfiles.about: Relays Commerce's findings about Bashi's earlier residence and departure from Japan.
subfiles.summary: Commerce could not explain Bashi's exit clearance and believed his firm no longer planned to send him.

subfiles.title: Correction of Vincenzo Onorato's flight number
subfiles.about: Corrects Onorato's Pan American flight number to 821.
subfiles.summary: The firm corrects Onorato's San Francisco departure flight from A-21 to 821.

subfiles.title: Exit-permit waiver for Vincenzo Onorato
subfiles.about: Records waiver of Onorato's exit permit.
subfiles.summary: Exit permit waived for Onorato's April 19 departure from San Francisco to Japan.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Captain Rawls about Michael Shalfeieff
subfiles.about: Determines whether permanent resident Shalfeieff needs a military permit.
subfiles.summary: Captain Rawls says a bona fide permanent resident of Japan requires no military permit to return.

subfiles.title: Speedletter to S. Holland concerning Shalfeieff
subfiles.about: Confirms Shalfeieff's exit waiver and expected permit-free reentry to Japan.
subfiles.summary: State waives Shalfeieff's exit permit and reports that his permanent-resident status should permit reentry without a military permit.

subfiles.title: Exit-permit waiver for Michael Shalfeieff
subfiles.about: Records Shalfeieff's exit-permit waiver.
subfiles.summary: Waiver approved for the permanent resident's April 24 return to Japan after medical treatment.

subfiles.title: Army request for reporting Soviet-bloc transit travelers
subfiles.about: Requests advance reports of Soviet and satellite nationals transiting Far East Command areas.
subfiles.summary: CINCFE seeks direct radio reports containing identifying and itinerary information for Soviet-bloc travelers through Japan, Korea, and Okinawa.

subfiles.title: State reply accepting Soviet-bloc traveler reporting
subfiles.about: Accepts CINCFE's requested reporting procedure.
subfiles.summary: State will instruct posts across Asia and Soviet-bloc countries to radio information on relevant U.S. visas to Far East Command intelligence.

subfiles.title: Telephone inquiry from S. Holland concerning Shalfeieff
subfiles.about: Discusses Shalfeieff's U.S. exit waiver and return to his home in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Corkran tells Holland that State will waive the exit permit and expects permanent-resident Shalfeieff to reenter Japan without a military permit. He cautions that State cannot guarantee entry.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on the Shalfeieff case
subfiles.about: Explains why an underlying Visa Division memorandum was not sent.
subfiles.summary: Holland's telephone call superseded the memorandum, which was retained to preserve continuity.

subfiles.title: Unsent memorandum requesting action on Shalfeieff's exit permit
subfiles.about: Requests either an exit waiver or issuance of an exit-permit card.
subfiles.summary: Corkran describes Shalfeieff as a stateless permanent resident and suggests issuing the simple exit card rather than processing a waiver.

subfiles.title: Action-copy cover sheet for file 894.111/4-1648
subfiles.about: Marks an action copy in the Japan travel file.
subfiles.summary: Action-copy divider bearing the file number.

subfiles.title: Request for Husni Halabi's clearance as a private trader
subfiles.about: Renews Halabi's application under private rather than official status.
subfiles.summary: Lebanon requests theater clearance for Halabi as a private trader and permission for a two- or three-month stay.

subfiles.title: New military permit for Julius Mueller
subfiles.about: Transmits Mueller's reissued May 1948 military permit.
subfiles.summary: State sends permit 9902, valid for Mueller's entry during May.

subfiles.title: Registered-mail envelope from Cosa Corporation
subfiles.about: Envelope for Cosa Corporation's registered air-mail correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Registered-air-mail envelope addressed to Corkran at the State Department.

subfiles.title: Request to extend Julius Mueller's permit
subfiles.about: Requests extension of Mueller's permit while he is traveling to Switzerland.
subfiles.summary: Delaney returns Mueller's permit and asks that its validity be extended through May 31.

subfiles.title: Return of Mueller's permit for revalidation
subfiles.about: Asks the Army to revalidate Mueller's permit for May.
subfiles.summary: State returns permit 9902 because Mueller's Switzerland trip prevents its use during April.

subfiles.title: Lebanese request for Halabi's private-trader clearance
subfiles.about: Requests clearance and a two- or three-month stay for Halabi.
subfiles.summary: Lebanon accepts private-trader status for Halabi and asks SCAP to allow an extended stay.

subfiles.title: Denial of permit extension for Husain W. Ahmed
subfiles.about: Declines to extend Ahmed's Japan military permit.
subfiles.summary: Army says Pakistani applicants should seek Japanese entry through British authorities, Pakistan's protecting power.

subfiles.title: Manila telegram concerning Edward H. Danks
subfiles.about: Requests guidance and Japanese entry authority for Edward H. Danks.
subfiles.summary: Manila describes conflicting U.S. and British instructions over which government should sponsor Danks's business application.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Manila on the Danks application
subfiles.about: Reports that Danks's application and the procedural issue remain under consideration.
subfiles.summary: State says the exceptional application is being presented while the jurisdictional question is discussed.

subfiles.title: Telegram to SCAP concerning Edward H. Danks
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Repeats Manila's request and states State's preferred procedure for alien employees of U.S. firms.
subfiles.summary: State urges favorable action on Danks and argues that U.S. representatives should handle alien employees traveling on U.S.-firm business. It asks SCAP to notify Manila directly.

subfiles.title: Charge slip for file 894.111/4-2248
subfiles.about: Records the charging or circulation of a file item.
subfiles.summary: Charge slip listing the file number and clerical handling marks.

subfiles.title: Mexico Embassy airgram on returning Japanese nationals
subfiles.about: Apparently asks what documentation Japanese nationals need to return to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Largely illegible incoming airgram that prompted the May 4 guidance on returning Japanese nationals.

subfiles.title: Reply on entry of returning Japanese nationals
subfiles.about: States that returning Japanese require no special entry documentation.
subfiles.summary: State understands that neither Military Government nor Japanese regulations require special documents from returning Japanese nationals.

subfiles.title: Transfer sheet for Army correspondence
subfiles.about: Records transfer of an April 23 Army item to another file number.
subfiles.summary: Transfer sheet documenting the refiling of Army Department correspondence.

subfiles.title: Technical correction to Soviet-bloc reporting airgram
subfiles.about: Proposes routing coded reports through USPOLAD Tokyo rather than directly to Army G-2.
subfiles.summary: Protective Services identifies a code problem and recommends sending reports to USPOLAD for transmission to Far East Command.

subfiles.title: Action-copy divider sheets
subfiles.about: Two sparse action-copy sheets mark correspondence in the Japan travel file.
subfiles.summary: Action-copy dividers with a file number and clerical marks.

subfiles.title: Telegram repeating Dairen dispatch 51
subfiles.about: Orders repetition to Shanghai of Dairen's April 26 telegram.
subfiles.summary: Code room is instructed to repeat Dairen telegram 51 to Shanghai as Department telegram 840.

subfiles.title: Memorandum to Lebanon concerning Alfred Bridi
subfiles.about: Reports Bridi's approved July entry and explains how he may seek longer residence.
subfiles.summary: Military authorities permit Bridi to enter during July for a limited stay. Because he requested one year, State advises applying to occupation authorities for semi-permanent residence after arrival and inserting the required Circular 8 statement in his passport.

subfiles.title: File note concerning letter to J. D. Scott
subfiles.about: Identifies correspondence to Scott associated with the Lebanese application.
subfiles.summary: Sparse file note linking the Lebanese case to an April 30 letter to Scott.

subfiles.title: Application of Alfred Bridi to enter Japan
subfiles.about: Seeks a one-year business visit to protect Bridi's interests in an import-export company.
subfiles.summary: Lebanese merchant Bridi proposes travel to Kobe in June or July 1948 to oversee the Orient Brazil Exporting Company.

subfiles.title: Excerpt from Alfred Bridi's business agreement
subfiles.about: Supports Bridi's claimed commercial interest.
subfiles.summary: Fragmentary agreement sets partnership, arbitration, property-return, profit, and renewal terms beginning May 1, 1937.

subfiles.title: Submission of Alfred Bridi's application to the Army
subfiles.about: Forwards Bridi's application and contract for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: State asks Army to obtain a decision; a memorandum of theater clearance will suffice if approved.

subfiles.title: Routing slip for Greek Embassy note
subfiles.about: Forwards a Greek Embassy note for action.
subfiles.summary: Internal routing slip sends the attached Greek note to Protective Services.

subfiles.title: Delay note on attached case
subfiles.about: Records that an attached case had awaited action for some time.
subfiles.summary: Brief handwritten note concerning delay in processing the case.

subfiles.title: Greek Embassy request for Chryssanthopoulos
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Chryssanthopoulos to study opening a Japanese office.
subfiles.summary: The Greek ambassador seeks SCAP permission for the Shanghai-based exporter, represented in America by Andrew Gall, to visit Japan.

subfiles.title: Application of Peter Chryssanthopoulos to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Seeks indefinite business travel to Japan and Korea.
subfiles.summary: Greek exporter Chryssanthopoulos lists major Shanghai commercial references and proposes travel as soon as permitted.

subfiles.title: Submission of Chryssanthopoulos application
subfiles.about: Forwards Chryssanthopoulos's application and clarifies his name and business purposes.
subfiles.summary: State notes that the application says Peter but other papers identify Paul Chryssanthopoulos Jr. He plans to examine a Japanese cotton-waste office and Korean export sources for paper-pulp material.

subfiles.title: Telegram approving Chon Nien Hsieh's entry
subfiles.about: Communicates military approval for Hsieh's Japanese business visit.
subfiles.summary: Hsieh may enter Japan during May for sixty days and must carry photographs and the required certification.

subfiles.title: Army notice of Hsieh and Liewer clearances
subfiles.about: Lists approved entry periods for Chon Nien Hsieh and Robert Liewer.
subfiles.summary: Army reports May clearances for Hsieh from Shanghai and Liewer from Saigon.

subfiles.title: Conversation concerning Hira Singh's permit
subfiles.about: Confirms that Singh's May permit has arrived and is acceptable.
subfiles.summary: Oliphant asks that Singh's military permit be mailed to Barret Textile Corporation.

subfiles.title: Military permit letter for Hira Singh
subfiles.about: Transmits Singh's May permit and requests departure information.
subfiles.summary: State sends permit 12444 and asks for Singh's itinerary so his exit permit can be waived.

subfiles.title: Conversation concerning Nessim Frangi's permit
subfiles.about: Arranges delivery of Frangi's military permit through Tradelines International.
subfiles.summary: Blackner says Frangi will travel from Europe through the United States; Corkran requests eventual departure details.

subfiles.title: Commerce application for Nessim Frangi
subfiles.about: Supports Frangi's proposed commercial visit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The partly illegible application identifies Frangi as a Greek national seeking Japanese sources of supply; Lionel L. Mattner certifies it.

subfiles.title: Military permit letter for Nessim Frangi
subfiles.about: Transmits Frangi's May permit and requests his travel itinerary.
subfiles.summary: State sends permit 12443 and asks for departure details needed to waive Frangi's exit permit.

subfiles.title: Circular airgram on Soviet-bloc transit travelers
subfiles.to: Certain American diplomatic and consular officers
subfiles.about: Orders reporting of visas issued to Soviet and satellite nationals transiting Far East Command areas.
subfiles.summary: Posts must radio USPOLAD Tokyo with identity and itinerary information for specified nationals traveling through Japan, Korea, or Okinawa.

subfiles.title: Draft circular on Soviet-bloc transit reporting
subfiles.to: Certain American diplomatic and consular officers
subfiles.about: Drafts the Soviet-bloc traveler reporting instruction.
subfiles.summary: Earlier draft directs reports toward Far East Command and bears the handwritten USPOLAD routing correction.

subfiles.title: Routing notes for Soviet-transit circular
subfiles.about: Provides fragmentary internal instructions for dispatch and handling of the circular.
subfiles.summary: Sparse routing fragments direct dispatch through the Visa Division and discuss the Soviet-transit problem.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on Americo Guerra's application
subfiles.about: Records Erny Trumpy's efforts to supply additional information supporting Guerra's application.
subfiles.summary: Trumpy explains that Guerra wants to restore a twenty-four-year commercial relationship between Japanese and Argentine firms. Corkran suggests obtaining an Argentine Embassy note, which Trumpy delivers later that day.

subfiles.title: Commerce transmittal of approved Japan travelers
subfiles.about: Forwards a Commerce-approved list of prospective travelers and foreign applications.
subfiles.summary: Commerce sends applicants approved subject to final SCAP action.

subfiles.title: Commerce list of approved Japan travelers
subfiles.about: Lists approved representatives, firms, citizenship, locations, and desired entry dates.
subfiles.summary: The four-page list covers U.S. and foreign representatives of trading, textile, shipping, engineering, and manufacturing firms across several American cities and Asian posts.

subfiles.title: Argentine Embassy note supporting Americo Guerra
subfiles.about: Endorses information supplied by Erny Trumpy about Guerra's plans.
subfiles.summary: The embassy authenticates Trumpy's statements and requests their submission to military authorities.

subfiles.title: Additional information on Americo Guerra
subfiles.about: Explains Guerra's plan to restore Argentine-Japanese commercial relations.
subfiles.summary: State asks Army to obtain theater clearance and issue a permit deliverable through Guerra's New York agent.

subfiles.title: Army notice of denied and pending Commerce applicants
subfiles.about: Reports denials for Steiner and Chun Poo Hsieh and pending action on Moiseeff.
subfiles.summary: Two Langdon representatives are refused because the firm already has two approved travelers; Moiseeff remains pending.

subfiles.title: Military permit letter for Moise Moiseeff
subfiles.about: Transmits Moiseeff's June military permit and requests travel details.
subfiles.summary: Permit 334 is valid during June; Moiseeff must provide his itinerary or return it if unusable.

subfiles.title: Application of Moise Moiseeff to visit Japan
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Seeks a commercial trip to inspect goods and arrange further textile-related production.
subfiles.summary: A. Ponve Company's manager proposes visits to Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka, and Kobe to inspect contracted goods and prepare new orders.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Army notice of denied and pending applicants
subfiles.about: Duplicates the notice regarding Langdon representatives and Moiseeff.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate records two denials under the two-representative rule and Moiseeff's pending case.

subfiles.title: E. W. Langdon and Company application
subfiles.from: E. W. Langdon and Company representatives
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Requests Japan travel for four company representatives engaged in engineering and electronics trade.
subfiles.summary: The application names Langdon, Steiner, Chon Nien Hsieh, and Chun Poo Hsieh and lists Yokohama, Tokyo, Kobe, and Osaka as destinations.

subfiles.title: Request to replace Isaac and Jose Dabah with Clemen Dabah
subfiles.about: Returns two permits and asks for a June permit in another partner's name.
subfiles.summary: The firm returns permits 8211 and 8212 and requests a June permit for Clemen Dabah.
